name: Whirling Advance follows the direction the Barbarian is moving (#7668)
contract: Issue #7668: pressing Q, E or S and then using Whirling Advance always launched the Barbarian forward, so the mobility move could not be used while kiting or backpedalling. Whirling Advance's effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE_DEST with EffectImplicitTargetA TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT, and Spell::SelectImplicitCasterDestTargets resolves that destination with WorldObject::MovePositionToFirstCollision(pos, dist, 0) around the caster's current orientation, so the charge spline always ran along the facing direction whatever movement key was held. CoA spells that already follow the movement keys read MOVEMENTFLAG_FORWARD/BACKWARD/STRAFE_LEFT/STRAFE_RIGHT and take the movement angle (AscensionPyromancer.cpp and AscensionWitchHunterAbilities.cpp both do this), so the same reading is applied to the Whirling Advance ranks (root 500919, ranks 504912-504916) through the OnDestinationTargetSelect hook. SpellRadius 32 gives the charge 12 yd. The fixture faces +X (orientation 0) with a dummy 30 yd ahead, so each successful cast moves the Barbarian about 12 yd: with no key held the gap closes, with S held (MOVEMENTFLAG_BACKWARD) the gap must open, and with Q held (MOVEMENTFLAG_STRAFE_LEFT) the gap must stay roughly the same. Expected before the fix: every cast closes the gap by about 12 yd, whichever key is held. The movement flag is set through the harness rather than a real client, so this establishes the server-side destination only; client rendering and the feel of the leap are not covered.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Barbarian knows Whirling Advance
Gap to the dummy before any cast
CONTROL: stand still and use Whirling Advance
SETUP: the standing cast was accepted
Let the standing charge finish
CONTROL: a standing Barbarian still charges forward, closing the 30 yd gap by the 12 yd radius
Hold S: backpedal without turning
SETUP: the Barbarian is moving
Gap before the backpedalling cast
Whirling Advance while holding S
SETUP: the backpedalling cast was accepted
Let the backpedalling charge finish
DISCRIMINATING: holding S carries the Barbarian away from the target it faces, opening the gap by the 12 yd radius
Release S
SETUP: the Barbarian has stopped
Hold Q: strafe left without turning
SETUP: the Barbarian is moving sideways
Gap before the strafing cast
Let the two spent charges recharge, as the ability carries them serially
Whirling Advance while holding Q
SETUP: the strafing cast was accepted
Let the strafing charge finish
DISCRIMINATING: holding Q carries the Barbarian sideways instead of closing on the target ahead
Release Q
SETUP: the Barbarian has stopped again
